def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp in seconds as HH:MM:SS in UTC."""
    pre ts >= 0
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    day_sec = ts % 86400
    h = day_sec // 3600
    m = (day_sec % 3600) // 60
    s = day_sec % 60
    h_str = str(h) if h >= 10 else "0" + str(h)
    m_str = str(m) if m >= 10 else "0" + str(m)
    s_str = str(s) if s >= 10 else "0" + str(s)
    return h_str + ":" + m_str + ":" + s_str
